details:
tl;dr at the bottom

Since the user status feature was introduced, I've observed some sore spots with it that I believe myself and others would like to have addressed. 

To start, I'm referring to the three user states that you can pick in the social tab: Active, Join Me, and Busy.

In this post I will only be focusing on 'Busy', as it where I have the most problems. Currently, when setting yourself to Busy, you will no longer receive notifications. That is the only purpose of Busy. I believe this is completely redundant in its usage, as users are capable of turning off their HUD, which also hides notifications from being seen. 

There are often situations where I will be hanging out with a group of people where I would not like other groups of friends joining. This is a simple compartmentalization situation. For example, would you like your friends to come bother you when spending time with your family, or vice versa? In most cases, I assume this to be "no". In this situation, I will set my status to "Busy" and request that no one joins me in my status message. The caveat here is that my friends can no longer grab my attention in-app, as I won't be receiving notifications, but I also can not stop any user from joining me even in this state as someone can simply choose to not read or ignore my status. 

For some, the solution to this problem would be to use an Invite or Invite+ instance, but I find it unreasonable to shove an entire group of people into a different instance type because one person would prefer to be "Busy". My suggestion in this case would to alter the effects of Busy. Instead of hiding notifications, I would rather have busy act as if that user is in an Invite+ instance, unless that user is in an Invite Only instance, where the effects of that instance type would instead take precedence.

For example; I am in a Friends+ with Group 1. I would like to hang out with Group 1 uninterrupted, so I set myself to Busy, preventing Group 2 from joining me. Group 1 is unaffected, as they are present in the same instance as me, but Group 2 sees me as "In a private world" (although in this case, I would prefer this be replaced with "User is Busy"). Instead of hiding notifications, Group 2 would be able to request an invite from me at any time, and I can accept or deny those invites as I see fit. This allows Group 2 to grab my attention if needed, while also not interrupting my interactions with Group 1. If I would prefer not to receive notifications, I can simply turn my HUD off in the UI menu. The downside to that is that I would no longer see my mic indicator but under this change I would see the mic indicator and notification UI elements separated into two different toggles under the UI menu.

The benefits here are obvious to me: I can choose which social circles I want to spend time in, uninterrupted if I choose, while also being available to other social circles in-app if they wish to grab my attention by sending me an invite. If I want to be entirely unreachable for whatever reason, I can turn off notifications under the UI tab and enjoy my time freely without worry of someone joining me uninvited. 

tl;dr make busy unjoinable and separate mic indicator and notifications into two separate elements.
title: Refresh the Functionality of User Status
